A Real Denver Barbershop

Urban Barbers at 38th is where the neighborhood comes for a cut done right. No rushing, no guesswork — just skilled barbers who take the time to get your look exactly the way you want it.

Whether it's a sharp skin fade, a clean beard line, or a classic hot-towel shave, you walk out looking like the best version of yourself. That's the standard at every chair.

Good to Know

FAQ

Do you take walk-ins?

Yes — walk-ins are always welcome. Booking a chair ahead guarantees your time and barber, especially on weekends.

How do I book a chair?

Use the booking form above, tap to call us, or message our booking assistant in the chat — it sets you up in seconds.

Do you do beard work and shaves?

Absolutely. Beard shaping, lineups, and classic hot-towel straight-razor shaves.

What are your prices?

Pricing depends on the service and barber. Call (720) 549-9756 or message us and we'll confirm the current rate before you book.

What payment do you accept?

Cash and all major cards. Tips appreciated, never expected.
